# cc-profiles

> cc-profiles is a free, open-source local web UI to manage multiple Claude Code profiles (configuration folders such as ~/.claude and ~/.claude-work, selected with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) on one macOS or Linux computer. It moves projects, memories and conversations between profiles, edits every /config setting, builds the status line, shares skills and plugins, shows token usage, and backs up every change so it can be undone.

- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andreaiannarone/cc-profiles/main/install.sh | sh`, or `pipx install cc-profiles`, then `cc-profiles open` (or `/cc-profiles` inside Claude Code).
- Runs on 127.0.0.1 only, Python 3.9+ standard library, no dependencies; never copies login credentials between profiles.
- License GPL-3.0-or-later. Author: Andrea Iannarone (https://andreaiannarone.com). Source: https://github.com/andreaiannarone/cc-profiles. Package: https://pypi.org/project/cc-profiles/.
